title: Herbal and Yogurt Tart
description: A refreshing dessert that combines the sweetness of tart with the tanginess of yogurt, topped with an herbal twist.
instructions: 2. Roll out the tart and place it on a baking sheet.
3. Bake the tart for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
4. In a medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, honey, mint leaves, lemon zest, and salt.
5. Once the tart is ready, let it cool for 5 minutes.
6. Top the tart with the yogurt mixture.
7. Chill the tart in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
8. Slice the tart into wedges and serve.
9. Garnish with additional mint leaves if desired.
